description_en: Queries the configuration and status of a specified data migration scheduled task
description_zh: 查询指定数据迁移定时任务的配置与状态
name: GetMmsTimer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduled task
parameters.name: timer_id

config.description_en: The configuration of the migration job

additionalProperties.description_en: The mapping between source column names and destination column names

columnMapping.description_en: The mapping between source column names and destination column names

enableDataMigration.description_en: Specifies whether to migrate table data

enableSchemaMigration.description_en: Specifies whether to migrate the table schema

enableVerification.description_en: Specifies whether to enable verification. Currently, the verification method is to execute SELECT COUNT on the source and destination to compare the number of rows
enableVerification.description_zh: 开启校验，目前校验方式是在源和目标端执行select count，对比行数

additionalProperties.description_en:
The partition filter expression. Example: p1 >= '2022-03-04' and (p2 = 10 or p3 > 20) and p4 in ('abc', 'cde'). The rules are as follows:

p1, p2, and p3 are partition names.

Partition values only contain strings and numbers. Strings are enclosed in double or single quotation marks.

Except for partition column values of the INT and BIGINT types, partition values of other types can only be strings.

Comparison operators include: >, >=, =, <, <=, and <>.

The partition filter expression supports the IN operator.

Logical operators include: AND and OR.

Parentheses are supported
additionalProperties.description_zh:
分区过滤表达式。例如：p1 >= '2022-03-04' and (p2 = 10 or p3 > 20) and p4 in ('abc', 'cde')，介绍如下：

p1、p2 和 p3 均为分区名。

分区值仅包含字符串和数字，字符串被双引号或单引号包裹。

除 INT 和 BIGINT 类型的分区列值外，其他类型的分区值都只能取字符串值。

比较操作符包括：>、>=、= 、<、<=、<>。

分区过滤表达式支持 IN 操作符。

逻辑操作符包括：AND 和 OR。

支持使用括号

partitionFilters.description_en: The partition filter expression. This parameter specifies the partition filter expression for a table
partitionFilters.description_zh: 分区过滤表达式。 配置指定"表"对应的"分区过滤表达式"

partitions.description_en: The list of partition IDs of the tables to migrate. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Partitions
partitions.description_zh: 当 type=Partitions 时, 通过该参数指定要迁移表的分区 ID 列表

items.description_en: The partition ID of the table to migrate

tableBlackList.description_en: The list of tables to exclude from migration. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Database
tableBlackList.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 通过 tableBlackList 指定排除哪些表不迁移

items.description_en: The table to exclude from migration
items.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 要排除的表

additionalProperties.description_en: The mapping between source table names and destination table names
additionalProperties.description_zh: 源表名->目标名 映射

tableMapping.description_en: The mapping between source table names and destination table names
tableMapping.description_zh: 源表名->目标名 映射

tableWhiteList.description_en: The list of tables to migrate. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Database. If tableWhiteList is not specified, all tables in the corresponding database are migrated
tableWhiteList.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 指定的要迁移的表列表。如果没有指定 tableWhiteList，则迁移对应 Database 下的所有表

items.description_en: The table to migrate when type is set to Database
items.description_zh: 当 type=Database 时， 指定的要迁移的表

tables.description_en: The list of names of the tables to migrate. This parameter takes effect when type is set to Tables
tables.description_zh: 当 type=Tables 时, 通过该参数指定要迁移的表的名称列表

items.description_en: The name of the table to migrate

createTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
createTime.description_zh:
任务创建时间。
采用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

dbId.description_en: The ID of the source database

id.description_en: The ID of the scheduled task

name.description_en: The name of the scheduled task

scheduleType.description_en: The scheduling type of the scheduled task

sourceId.description_en: The ID of the data source

srcDbName.description_en: The name of the source database

stopped.description_en: Indicates whether the task is stopped

updateTime.description_en: The latest update time of the scheduled task. The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone, in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format
updateTime.description_zh:
定时任务最新更新时间。
格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC，例如 YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

value.description_en: The scheduling time of the scheduled task. When scheduleType is set to Daily, the value is in the HH:MM format. When scheduleType is set to Hourly, the value is in the MM format
